SELECT * FROM ASSET WHERE IS_DELETED = 'N'
AND LOWER(NAME) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{q}) || '%'
AND STATUS = 'AVAILABLE'
ORDER BY ASSET_ID

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ASSET WHERE IS_DELETED = 'N'
AND LOWER(NAME) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{q}) || '%'
AND STATUS = 'AVAILABLE'

SELECT MIN(a.ASSET_ID) AS ASSET_ID, a.NAME, a.CATEGORY, a.COMPANY, MIN(a.STATUS) AS STATUS, MIN(a.IMAGE) AS IMAGE, MIN(a.MAINTENANCE_CYCLE) AS MAINTENANCE_CYCLE, MIN(a.USAGE_TIME) AS USAGE_TIME, MIN(a.LAST_MAINTENANCE_DATE) AS LAST_MAINTENANCE_DATE, MIN(a.EXPECTED_MAINTENANCE_DATE) AS EXPECTED_MAINTENANCE_DATE, MIN(a.CREATED_AT) AS CREATED_AT, MIN(a.UPDATED_AT) AS UPDATED_AT, MIN(a.DELETED_AT) AS DELETED_AT, MIN(a.IS_DELETED) AS IS_DELETED, COUNT(*) AS STOCK, COUNT(*) - COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.ASSET_ID) FROM ASSET a2 INNER JOIN RESERVATION r ON a2.ASSET_ID = r.ASSET_ID WHERE a2.NAME = a.NAME AND a2.CATEGORY = a.CATEGORY AND a2.COMPANY = a.COMPANY AND r.STATUS IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED', 'ACTIVE') AND r.END_TIME > SYSDATE AND a2.IS_DELETED = 'N' ), 0) AS AVAILABLE_STOCK, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.ASSET_ID) FROM ASSET a2 INNER JOIN RESERVATION r ON a2.ASSET_ID = r.ASSET_ID WHERE a2.NAME = a.NAME AND a2.CATEGORY = a.CATEGORY AND a2.COMPANY = a.COMPANY AND r.STATUS IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED', 'ACTIVE') AND r.END_TIME > SYSDATE AND a2.IS_DELETED = 'N' ), 0) AS RENTED_STOCK FROM ASSET a WHERE a.IS_DELETED = 'N'
AND LOWER(a.NAME) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{q}) || '%'
GROUP BY a.NAME, a.CATEGORY, a.COMPANY
HAVING COUNT(*) - COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.ASSET_ID) FROM ASSET a2 INNER JOIN RESERVATION r ON a2.ASSET_ID = r.ASSET_ID WHERE a2.NAME = a.NAME AND a2.CATEGORY = a.CATEGORY AND a2.COMPANY = a.COMPANY AND r.STATUS IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED', 'ACTIVE') AND r.END_TIME > SYSDATE AND a2.IS_DELETED = 'N' ), 0) > 0
ORDER BY a.NAME, a.CATEGORY, a.COMPANY
OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{pageSize} ROWS ONLY

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT a.NAME, a.CATEGORY, a.COMPANY FROM ASSET a WHERE a.IS_DELETED = 'N'
AND LOWER(a.NAME) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{q}) || '%'
GROUP BY a.NAME, a.CATEGORY, a.COMPANY
HAVING EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ASSET a2 WHERE a2.NAME = a.NAME AND a2.CATEGORY = a.CATEGORY AND a2.COMPANY = a.COMPANY AND a2.IS_DELETED = 'N' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM RESERVATION r WHERE r.ASSET_ID = a2.ASSET_ID AND r.STATUS IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED', 'ACTIVE') AND r.END_TIME > SYSDATE ) )
)

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ASSET WHERE IS_DELETED = 'N' AND NAME = #{name} AND (CATEGORY = #{category} OR (CATEGORY IS NULL AND #{category} IS NULL)) AND (COMPANY = #{company} OR (COMPANY IS NULL AND #{company} IS NULL))

SELECT a.* FROM ASSET a WHERE a.IS_DELETED = 'N' AND a.NAME = #{name} AND (a.CATEGORY = #{category} OR (a.CATEGORY IS NULL AND #{category} IS NULL)) AND (a.COMPANY = #{company} OR (a.COMPANY IS NULL AND #{company} IS NULL)) AND a.STATUS = 'AVAILABLE' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM RESERVATION r WHERE r.ASSET_ID = a.ASSET_ID AND r.STATUS IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED', 'ACTIVE') AND r.END_TIME > SYSDATE ) ORDER BY a.ASSET_ID
